get.description: Retrieve a single-date department-by-location daily report.

parameters.name: departments
parameters.description: Comma-separated department names. If omitted, default DailyReport departments are used.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: Comma-separated location names. If omitted, default DailyReport locations are used.

parameters.name: includeEmpty
parameters.description: Set true to include zero-value department rows

get.description: Retrieve department-wise registration counts for up to three report dates.

parameters.name: dates
parameters.description: Comma-separated report dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-06-01,2026-06-02,2026-06-03

parameters.name: date1
parameters.description: First report date in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: date2
parameters.description: Second report date in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: date3
parameters.description: Third report date in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: includeEmpty
parameters.description: Set true to include departments with zero registrations
